name: Environment-Coupled Development / Plasticity
purpose: Prove that the same genome, inherited developmental traits and IndividualSeed produce explainably different realized developmental programs and GrowthGraphs under different continuous EnvironmentSample inputs without mutating heredity or accepted ecology/resource truth.

accepted_evidence.graphical_observation: PASS_BY_USER_OBSERVATION_DIAGNOSTIC: visible plant representation changes between probes, including leaf-like lateral elements and stem/petiole-length differences; presentation remains non-canonical

acceptance_semantics: genome checksum is identical across all environment probes
inherited development checksum is identical across all environment probes
IndividualSeed is identical across all environment probes
EnvironmentSample changes only the realized developmental program and derived GrowthGraph
shade elongates the axis while suppressing crown branching/spread
drought and flood suppress realized size
nutrient availability changes realized extension continuously
accepted P1 resource equations are not modified
